title: Catalog: every demo and class card you may not have seen, previewed on one page

chat.text: One page computed from the site's own page tree: every module or demo with a UI as a card with a live preview, click through to the full demo, the ones landed since October marked as probably unseen; a section of every class card (icon + core API) with Refine, Dictate and System first; and a verdict on whether the live instance-hierarchy view you asked for exists, linked if so.
